arguments.sql: SELECT customers.name AS Client, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS Montant FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE customers.country = 'DE' AND orders.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY customers.name

arguments.subject: Montant total commandé 2026 - Clients DE
arguments.body: Voici le montant total commandé en 2026 par chaque client du pays DE.

with_the_gate.answer: La feuille report_10.xlsx avec les montants 2026 des clients DE a été envoyée à Claire Dumont.
